content: Implement the first M0130 W0134 execution-stream slice: plan Graph IR stream submissions with per-stream FIFO, explicit cross-stream dependencies, copy/launch visibility masks, and generation checks before future vkQueueSubmit2 integration; do not claim Vulkan execution or performance evidence.

Content revision c3b8c5e adds StreamGraph to the Vulkan runtime. It assigns monotonic submission sequences, preserves same-stream FIFO, requires explicit cross-stream waits, validates transfer/compute visibility masks, and rejects stale generations, unknown streams, future dependencies, duplicates, and dependency overflow.

Vulkan configure/build and full CTest passed 86/86, including stream-graph positive and negative fixtures; Agent records and git diff checks passed. No vkQueueSubmit2, pipeline execution, or timing qualification is claimed.
